meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (1MA1_2H_2506). Derived metadata only — question numbers, marks and skill tags. No exam question text transcribed.
meta.note: Marks per part read from the question paper's own part totals and checked against the printed 80. Questions 1 to 8 are the overlap questions shared with 2F (2F q20 to q27) and are tagged identically there.

coding_notes: q9 (expand a bracket by a term carrying a negative index) tagged fractional_and_negative_indices first, which files the item under Number even though it looks like algebra. The taxonomy puts every index skill under Number, and the negative index is what the question is actually testing.

q12c (whether a median of 35 means some value is 35) tagged median rather than box_plots: the claim is about what a median is, and box_plots would additionally credit cumulative_frequency for a one-mark statement.

q16 (two mathematically similar jars) tagged congruence_and_similarity. There is no 'similar solids / area and volume scale factors' node; this is the nearest, and it is the only one that claims anything true about the student.

q17 (constant of an exponential curve from a point with a negative x-coordinate) tagged fractional_and_negative_indices. The taxonomy has no exponential-graph node, and the mark scheme's whole method is inverting k to the power -1, which is exactly that skill.

q20 tagged understanding_straight_line_graphs + ratio: the point is found by dividing a segment in a ratio, then the line through it is handled in y = mx + c form. First skill chosen so the item files under Algebra with the gradient work.
q22 tagged equation_of_a_circle + translations; the sketch has to show the translated centre and the new y-axis intercepts.
